text:
maria: Heads-up — I'm drafting a compact battlecard pack aimed at infra/platform buyers (cross-sell motion). Want fast feedback on claims + routing before EOD :rocket:

jake: love it. what's the single most provocative claim?

maria: three short ones: 1) unified runtime across hosted/dedicated/private, 2) predictable per-token economics with batching+cache, 3) graceful degradation with automatic variant fallback. each needs one supporting datapoint and a 10-word rebuttal to common cloud/LLM API talking points.

olivia: can we avoid calling out specific vendor names in the external-facing battlecard? internal version can have competitor slugs.

maria: yes — public snippets generic, internal notes map to competitors. i'll add a competitor appendix.

sam-gtm: sample 10-word rebuttal attempts — take or leave: 
- For runtime: "Same API, fewer surprises — consistent perf across deployments."
- For cost: "Lower per-request spend via batching & KV caching automation."
- For reliability: "Fallbacks keep apps online when capacity shifts."

jake: those read well. can we back the cost claim with a short benchmark line? e.g., "avg token cost down 32% vs unmanaged endpoints on batchable chat workloads" — do we have a safe number?

maria: we have a bench from Jan2025 on web-chat workload: batching+cache reduced GPU tokens by ~28–35% depending on seq dist. i'll cite the lower bound 28% and mark it internal until approvals.

olivia: routing ask — how should inbound leads for "platform" vs "app" be routed? ops wants deterministic rules.

maria: suggested rule (pseudocode):
```
if lead.tags contains "infra" or lead.feature_request contains "SLA" then route_to = "AE-infra"
else if lead.company_size > 200 and lead.use_case in ["search","embeddings"] then route_to = "AE-data"
else route_to = "growth-plg"
```

sam-gtm: add a condition for "private-deploy" keywords so sales can triage enterprise needs early.

maria: good call. will add.

jake: webinar hook suggestion — title: "Keeping LLMs Predictable: Serving at Scale Without the Surprise Bill". 30-minute slot: 15m bench highlights, 10m product demo, 5m Q&A.

olivia: we should pair that with a one-pager comparing failure modes (latency spike, OOM, blackholing requests) vs how our fallbacks address them. quick visual.

maria: i'll produce two variants: one technical (for infra buyers) and one exec-friendly (for PLG + product).

sam-gtm: A/B test these CTA texts on the landing page: 
- "See how we cut per-token spend" vs "See predictable inference at scale"
- which do we want to route to AE vs self-serve?

maria: prefer spend CTA -> trial/growth; predictable inference -> AE-infra. we'll instrument with hidden form fields.

devbot: reminder: marketing assets must pass compliance checklist before external publication. See https://docs.redwood/marketing/compliance (auto-note).

jake: timeline check — can we have internal battlecards + routing rules by tomorrow morning? I can take first pass on competitor rebuttals.

maria: yes. i'll drop the draft in this thread in ~3 hours. please react with :eyes: when reviewed.

olivia: will prep the visual failure-mode chart, pinging design after this.

sam-gtm: i'll update the inbound routing rules in Growth Hub once we finalize pseudocode.

maria: thanks all — short and sharp please. aim is one internal slide and three 1-liners per claim for field handoff. :thumbsup:
